Situated in the sought-after and mature Woodlands development, this four-bedroom family home offers spacious, well-appointed accommodation in one of Navan's most established residential locations.

The property also feature a private rear garden with a decked area & shed, integrated garage and a paved driveway with parking for a number of vehicles.

Convenient access to schools, shops, recreational amenities, and transport links, making it an ideal choice for commuters and growing families alike. This is a wonderful opportunity to acquire a quality home in a well-established neighbourhood where properties are consistently in high demand.
